checker_runtime.description: The checker runtime the daemon assigned. "unassigned" when the run never started.

reported_model.description: The model the runtime said it used. Absent when it did not say.

deliverable_digest.description: Digest of the author deliverables this attempt checked, names and digests in name order.

counts_as.description: pass and fail stand. inconclusive, timeout, error, quota and cancelled count as inconclusive.

evidence.description:
Where to read the evidence: the run log, which holds the trace, the error and the outputs.
When a verification was admitted, verification_run_id names that record too.

verification_run_id.description: Set when a verification record was admitted for this attempt.

recheck_override.description: The signed override that allowed this attempt after a fail on the same digest.

description:
One checker attempt on one deliverable digest. Append-only: a later attempt is a new row.
Added in API 0.1; existing records are unchanged.
